overview.description: The Roundhill Photonics & Optics ETF (LYTE) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund is an actively managed ETF that invests primarily in companies involved in photonics and optical technologies. The fund seeks capital appreciation. LYTE was launched on Aug 6, 2026 and is issued by Roundhill.
